scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, I'd like to know the interest rate and total costs associated with the loan if it has been approved.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate is 5.99% and the total loan costs are $10,391.23.

dialogue.user: That's great news! Thank you for letting me know. I also wanted to ask if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan, and has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and does not have negative amortization. Your loan was sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you please tell me the name of the institution that purchased my loan? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: The purchaser is another type of purchaser. Your loan product is an FHA:First Lien.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I have a few more questions. What does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? And is there anything else I should know about my loan terms or costs?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 48%. This is the ratio of your monthly debt payments to your monthly income. The total loan costs are $10,391.23.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing that information. I think I have all the details I need. Based on our conversation, I feel well-informed and satisfied with the service I received.

<Very Satisfied> The agent was clear, courteous, and provided all the information I needed about my loan application.
